conservativeLimits: Category precedence is disjoint; protection flags and exact source matches remain independent and must be honored before removal.
Exact hash matching establishes byte identity, not musical acceptance, publication permission, durable backup or a deletion authorization.

Review references are exact SHA-256 strings in tracked song/sample review/delivery/manifest/retention JSON and evidence review/retention JSON; unstructured prose and arbitrary script dependencies are not exhaustively inferred.
Listening-named paths are a conservative value signal, not proof that every file is indispensable.
Recipe protection includes literal build inputs from tracked JSON stages; generated/dynamic paths hidden in arbitrary code may remain unclassified.
All unclassified, changed, unreadable, deferred and protected inputs remain in place. No missing reusable/public promotion is inferred automatically.
Verified recovery routes were checked against local Git/LFS or decoded canonical archive bytes; remote availability and off-machine backup were not tested.
Final stat identity checks detect ordinary changes but do not lock independent writers or detect a changed-and-reverted file.
Distinct-content byte figures overlap across categories; use the global total for cross-category content deduplication.
Existing cleanup candidates are exact cache/non-cache WAV matches, not approved deletion selections or total reclaimable storage.
scope: Read-only 2026-10-17 pre-cleanup build classification; own-score validation outputs excluded; no category grants publication or deletion permission.
